description: Turn requested software changes into auditable development workflows.

interface.longDescription: CC Flow turns requested software changes into an auditable workflow, checks product intent without unnecessary questioning, separates user needs from solutions, prefers suitable reuse or mature libraries over duplicate custom code, and guides implementation, testing, and review across repositories.
